problem: Portal quality cannot depend on one-off page fixes; dynamic portal views, visualizations and interactions need one inherited responsive and reliability authority.
decision: Introduce a final product-experience CSS/runtime layer, automatic visual fitting/overflow detection, interaction/runtime signals, narrow-mobile coverage and a machine-readable Powerhouse experience contract.
reusable_rules: Fix the shared portal experience layer before patching individual pages.
Any dynamically mounted portal view must inherit the same visual and interaction contract.
Visual overflow and runtime errors are Powerhouse quality signals, not cosmetic exceptions.
320px, 390px, tablet and desktop are explicit acceptance surfaces.
Do not widen visual thresholds to hide structural defects.
